Privacy & cookies

Effective: October 7, 2026

Site use and information processing

Battery Atlas provides battery technology and market information. It currently has no registration, payment or personal-information forms. Technology searches and value-calculator inputs are processed in the browser. The hosting service may process connection information, including IP addresses and request details, to deliver the site.

Advertising and cookies

Google AdSense code is installed on this site. Ad delivery depends on Google's review and account settings. Google and third-party advertising providers may use cookies or similar identifiers to serve ads based on visits to this and other sites, measure ad performance and prevent misuse.

When advertising functions run, the browser may send information such as IP address, visited page, browser and device details to Google. Processing and retention follow Google and relevant advertising providers' policies and user choices.

How Google uses information from partner sites · Google Privacy Policy

Manage advertising and cookie settings

Google My Ad Center lets you manage personalized advertising settings. Third-party advertising choice tools are also available. Browser settings allow cookie blocking and deletion. Turning off personalized ads does not remove all advertising.

External links and changes

When you open manufacturer or institutional links, their privacy policies apply. This notice and its effective date will be updated when advertising services or site functions change.
